Ziffr to Slack

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, the Slack channel id and your Slack app's bot user id (Slack: auth.test).
2. Add the Slack credential (the bot token) to the HTTP Request nodes. The bot must be a member of the channel.
3. Replace the Webhook path with a long random string, activate the workflow and put its production URL into the Webhook in Ziffr (events: action.created, action.done, alert.fired).

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/slack.md
